dedupe_keys.name: aosta valley landscape plan ski runs areas and lifts

description: The Autonomous Region of Aosta Valley publishes four complementary ski-infrastructure layers within its territorial landscape plan (PTP). Their titles identify downhill ski runs, ski areas, access lifts and ski lifts. The shared regional publisher, plan name and cartographic lineage establish one plan component group, with overlapping areas and installations. The abstract defines the general layout and rules for use and enhancement; it does not certify that every represented lift currently operates or that a proposal was constructed. Cartography was created on the regional numerical technical map at 1:10,000 in ED50/UTM32N. Metadata is dated December 2010; actual asset survey dates are unspecified. Distribution descriptors name GeoJSON and provide regional map-portal and WMS access. Native metadata states public access and links a provider reuse document whose precise terms were not read. Licence conditions and file-use costs therefore remain unknown. Capacity, lift technology, operating schedules, connectivity and specific simulation uses are not established. Related PTP transport and built-environment components remain separately identified. No feature, map or linked document body was read.
